cause: validation-report.md records executable runtime PASS for artifacts absent from the shared branch
impact: closed-loop runtime may be incorrectly consumed as executable-verified
fix_rule: Either recover the exact tested artifacts and rerun at END_HEAD, or downgrade the report to NOT_VERIFIED. Do not reconstruct evidence from inference.
prevention: Bind validation claims to exact HEAD plus committed artifact identities before PASS.
regression: Auditor checks artifact existence at evidence HEAD and reruns applicable tests before acceptance.
